nodes.label: Conductor Changelog
nodes.rationale: Chronological release record; historical entries describe their dated state rather than overriding the newer entries.

nodes.label: qa/reports/ab-report-v2.md
nodes.rationale: The dated v2.1.1 entry reports 27/27 traps at n=5 in both arms and reproduce-first in 12/12 debug reruns, with two extra median turns.

nodes.label: qa/reports/evidence-2026-09-26.log
nodes.rationale: Cited acceptance record for 80 Windows/Linux evidence tests and agent/disabled-guard probes; no false acceptance observed, acceleration not established.

nodes.label: tools/journal-report.sh (reference in CHANGELOG.md)
nodes.rationale: The 2026-08-21 entry separates volume and quality: PIPED is excluded from quality and relevant PASS and FAIL are required; readiness permits an experiment, not rule deletion.

nodes.label: crossmodel.conf
nodes.rationale: Cross-model verifier selection comes from configuration instead of a hardcoded CLI.

nodes.label: Карта покрытия (требование задания → место в артефакте или MISSING)
nodes.rationale: Requirement-to-artifact-or-MISSING mapping checks completeness against the task; two omissions found on 2026-08-24 motivated explicit prewriting coverage plans.

nodes.label: Блок MODEL AND EFFORT
nodes.rationale: Subtask tier selects effort; the model inherits from the session, lighter models are limited to mechanically checkable output, and verification is no weaker than the work.

nodes.label: Блок PARALLEL MUTATION
nodes.rationale: Controller runs whole-tree gates once after serialization; changed paths are checked against declared scope before reports are trusted.

nodes.label: Соразмерная проверка
nodes.rationale: Display wording, comments and ordinary documents can finish by diff inspection; behavior changes need affected checks. Short decision probes are not speed or general model-reliability measurements.

nodes.label: Безопасная отмена правок
nodes.rationale: Exact pre-task snapshots and expected-byte checks protect user and untracked content; falsification reverses only the fix in a current isolated copy while retaining the test.

nodes.label: debugging.md
nodes.rationale: A failure first observed after an edit must be reproduced on the pre-edit state to distinguish pre-existing debt from a regression.

nodes.label: implementing.md
nodes.rationale: The dated August entry introduces remove-only guard falsification and task-based coverage; its unconditional integrity-guard wording is later qualified by September impact-based verification.

nodes.label: methods.md
nodes.rationale: CRITERIA FIRST requires mandatory document items before drafting so the coverage map can detect omitted requirements.

nodes.label: orchestration.md
nodes.rationale: Parallel mutation, scoped paths, long jobs first and coverage maps are documented here; later August additions serialize controller acceptance and set model/effort policy.

nodes.label: docs/PARALLEL-WORK.md
nodes.rationale: Research material remains in docs and is not deployed into runtime; duplicate existing rules were deliberately not copied.

nodes.label: docs/PROOF-LOOP.md
nodes.rationale: Research input for the August rule changes; duplicative round counters, proportionality tiers and inversion were not copied.

nodes.label: skeptic.md
nodes.rationale: Verdicts require a stationary tree; coverage is checked against the assignment before substantive review.

nodes.label: subagent-contract.md
nodes.rationale: The contract adds a coverage map and unique namespaces for external resources; cleanup requires proven zeros and must preserve others' resources.

nodes.label: verification.md (proportional verification playbook)
nodes.rationale: Core, implementation, orchestration, skeptic, subagent contract, command hints, digests and three READMEs were aligned without increasing delivery budgets.

nodes.label: CI on Windows and Ubuntu
nodes.rationale: CLI, installation, local Git, conflict and rollback checks join both operating-system jobs; earlier entries also record lint and trust-path self-tests.

nodes.label: conductor status/update/rollback
nodes.rationale: status/update/rollback use a separate official Git copy; --check and --ref preserve language and reject manual edits, back up before writing and conditionally recover without overwriting later changes.

nodes.label: install-companions.sh (reference in CHANGELOG.md)
nodes.rationale: The historical August companion bundle is nonfatal and survives uninstall; newer September entries replace its Cargo/system-pip acquisition details and require verified plugin state.

nodes.label: install.sh (unified global installer)
nodes.rationale: One default installation covers all environments, --scope selects components and language is chosen once; ownership checks and prewrite snapshots protect reinstalls.

nodes.label: memory/recall.py (reference in CHANGELOG.md)
nodes.rationale: Reads inbox and full curated lessons; the agent judges context, recency only breaks relevance ties, PARTIAL reports read errors and no-match does not inject unrelated lessons.

nodes.label: qa/settings-json-test.py (reference in CHANGELOG.md)
nodes.rationale: The August release documents 12 tests and corrects the advertised count to the actual suite count; this is historical reporting, not a new run.

nodes.label: uninstall.sh (reference in CHANGELOG.md)
nodes.rationale: CLI removal verifies ownership using stored hashes and preserves recovery backups; companions and project adapters are outside updater scope.

nodes.label: Graphify isolated installation
nodes.rationale: Graphify now uses isolated uv/venv rather than system pip; working tools are reused and incomplete or missing-PATH outcomes are explicit.

nodes.label: Двухступенчатая память уроков (инбокс + курируемый стор с индексом)
nodes.rationale: Historical fixes rebuild the index, move inbox above the index, truncate complete UTF-8 lines and rotate before reads; current task-based retrieval is described in the September entry.

nodes.label: Выбор языка ответа (reply-language)
nodes.rationale: The rule corpus became English because Russian instructions biased visible reasoning; one replacement phrase and persisted reply-language choice control all three installers.

nodes.label: RTK release binary with SHA-256
nodes.rationale: The current installer downloads a ready-made checked binary without Cargo, superseding the older Cargo-based acquisition described in August.

nodes.label: superpowers (плагин)
nodes.rationale: Conductor supplies process discipline and superpowers workflow skills; exact plugin IDs and preference for an already-enabled copy avoid activating duplicates.

nodes.label: Память реальных проверок (run/list/show/check)
nodes.rationale: Optional run/list/show/check stores full execution evidence and input/environment snapshots outside projects; matching conditions are not a new passing test and damaged or incomplete evidence is refused.

nodes.label: README RU/EN/AZ
nodes.rationale: The three language editions document unified installation and CLI scope; September entries also update recall, saved evidence and proportional verification.

nodes.label: qa/lint-selftest.sh (reference in CHANGELOG.md)
nodes.rationale: The v2.1.0 entry introduces 13 negative lint cases alongside the Windows/Ubuntu CI jobs.

nodes.label: qa/lint.sh (reference in CHANGELOG.md)
nodes.rationale: Missing, duplicate or malformed thresholds are rejected; earlier releases also enforce rendered module paths and synchronized distillation thresholds.

nodes.label: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR
nodes.rationale: Lesson migration and distillation respect the configured Claude directory, matching other hooks and tools.

nodes.label: DISTILL_THRESHOLD
nodes.rationale: Lint checks synchronization of DISTILL_THRESHOLD across three files.

nodes.label: Бюджеты правил (лимиты размера модулей)
nodes.rationale: The dated August changes raise contract 2500 to 3000, implementing 6000 to 6500 and orchestration through 6500 to 7000; September alignment does not expand delivery budgets.

nodes.label: playbooks/distill.md
nodes.rationale: Distillation respects CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR; the release also records index reconstruction and threshold consistency.

nodes.label: HANDOFF.md
nodes.rationale: HANDOFF records the v2.0 state for which no retrospective tag was created.

nodes.label: qa/bench — A/B runner
nodes.rationale: Both arms exclude live user settings, each invocation has a separate workspace/evidence namespace, and an atomic manifest records commit, runtime digest and artifact identity.

nodes.label: audit-hooks (read-only проверка хуков)
nodes.rationale: Read-only structural audit checks exact events, matchers, commands and timeouts instead of relying on textual grep.

nodes.label: tools/doctor.sh (reference in CHANGELOG.md)
nodes.rationale: Doctor fails on an unrendered module base; release entries also add help flags and full-runtime checks.

nodes.label: Плейсхолдер __CONDUCTOR_DIR__
nodes.rationale: __CONDUCTOR_DIR__ replaces an author-machine hardcoded path so other machines can load playbooks; installation renders it and lint/doctor guard it.

nodes.label: core.md
nodes.rationale: The August entry defers redundant core edits for lack of space; a later historical entry explains fixing its hardcoded module base.

nodes.label: tools/build-digests.sh (reference in CHANGELOG.md)
nodes.rationale: The v2.0 release establishes adapters/core-body.md plus tools/build-digests.sh as the single digest source and builder.

nodes.label: §5.5 reply style
nodes.rationale: Reader order, active first-person verbs, concrete anchors and one idea per paragraph were added to global CLAUDE; transfer to the constrained digest was deferred.

nodes.label: adapters/core-body.md
nodes.rationale: Single digest body; the August reply-style transfer was deferred because digests occupied 11988 of the 12000-character external limit.

nodes.label: deploy/global-CLAUDE.md
nodes.rationale: The global values file receives the reader-centered §5.5 response style; the entry distinguishes it from the constrained core-body digest.

nodes.label: PowerShell/Bash archive bootstrap
nodes.rationale: Official archives are downloaded into a temporary directory without clone; unsafe archive paths, excessive size and failed downloads stop installation.

nodes.label: install-global.sh compatibility stage
nodes.rationale: Remains an internal compatible step after install.sh becomes the single required global installer.

nodes.label: Verified superpowers enabled state
nodes.rationale: List-read failure or unknown status cannot count as successful enablement; negative installer cases run in CI and companion failure remains nonfatal.

nodes.label: Applicable verification reuse
nodes.rationale: Inspected local, subagent and CI proof remains valid when relevant conditions are unchanged; staged content matters and pending CI is not green.

nodes.label: Private memory recovery and maintenance
nodes.rationale: Undated lessons go last, archive names do not collide, installed copies can be maintained without checkout, and private Git/project restores avoid overwrite.

nodes.label: Remove-only guard falsification
nodes.rationale: At T2+, removing only the new guard must turn the retained test red and restoration green, with both outputs reported.

nodes.label: Test-run evidence integrity
nodes.rationale: Journal mentions and ambiguous commands are separated from actual runs and stale rows cannot count as new evidence; benchmark and doctor checks are hardened.

nodes.label: settings-json.py leaf ownership
nodes.rationale: Only owned hook-command leaves are removed while foreign neighbors in the same entry survive.

nodes.label: test-run-journal.sh historical passive trace
nodes.rationale: The v2.0 entry calls this a passive execution trace; later entries qualify evidence quality and command recognition.

nodes.label: Removed marker commit gate
nodes.rationale: The historical marker gate is removed and --no-verify is no longer banned; discipline rests on proof before commit.

nodes.label: MIT license
nodes.rationale: v2.1.0 adds LICENSE with MIT licensing and the English README.

nodes.label: v2.0 delivery transition
nodes.rationale: The historical v2.0 layer moves to Bash, centralizes digests, adds two-stage memory and removes the marker gate and then-existing benchmark.

hyperedges.label: Дисциплина карты покрытия в правилах Conductor
